text: A card for Grandma. Background: a light pink rectangle, 780 by 480, in the center, named Card, background layer.
Heart time: a large red circle at 360,220, named LobeL
a second large red circle, LobeR, at 440,220
and a huge red diamond at 400,290 for the point, named Tip
group LobeL, LobeR and Tip as Heart
write "Thank you, Grandma" at the top in large magenta letters
Me on the left: a small yellow circle named MyHead, left of Heart with a 60 px gap
my body: an orange rectangle MyBody 2 px below MyHead
Grandma on the right side of the heart: a small white circle named GranHead, 60 px gap
her body, a purple rectangle called GranBody, directly below GranHead with a 2 px gap
group MyHead and MyBody as Me
and GranHead with GranBody as Gran
dotted arrows from MyBody and GranBody to Tip
label the arrow from GranBody to Tip "love"
Is MyHead left of GranHead?
five small pink stars in a row below the heart
make them gold, like little flowers
a sun in the top right: medium yellow circle named Sun
and a tiny white oval cloud near Sun
Is Tip in the center?
make GranBody pink, her favourite colour
how many circles do we have on the card?
bring the two lobes to the front
add a small purple hexagon near MyBody, a present for her
Which shapes are pink?
a tiny red diamond above MyHead
and the same tiny red diamond above GranHead
make both tiny diamonds magenta
what is near Sun?
Write "with love, Mia" under Me, small
Is the cloud white?
delete the cloud
move Gran 20 px to the right
Describe Tip.
how many groups are there?
which group is MyBody in?
Who is connected to Tip?
Make the title navy, no, keep it magenta but huge
Is Sun bigger than MyHead?
undo the title size
Lovely, Grandma will cry.
